subject: Week-long ctmm workshop in Corvallis, Oregon

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Week-long ctmm workshop in Corvallis, Oregon
parts:
The Oregon chapter of The Wildlife Society will be hosting a week-long ctmm workshop at Oregon State University from July 21st - 25th.  Workshop registration will be limited to 38 attendees, with reduced rates for early registration and for ORTWS members.

https://oregonchapterofthewildlifesociety.wildapricot.org/event-6111379

Best,
Chris

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Week-long ctmm workshop in Corvallis, Oregon
parts:
FYI, this is the last month to register for the 1-week workshop in July and this will be the only 1-week workshop in North America this year.

Best,
Chris
